title: rosa gallica var. ruralis
intro: Rosa gallica var. ruralis, commonly known as the French Lavender Rose, is a fragrant, pink-flowered rose species native to Europe and North Africa. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, promoting relaxation, and soothing digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Rosa gallica var. ruralis are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and act as an antiseptic agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and fragrant essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
